description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF4 allies are alive, grants [ATK and DEF +30% (25s)]/[ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies if 0-3/4+ FF4 allies are alive, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants Ladle +2 to the user if 4+ FF4 allies and Yang are alive
